decisions.reason: As a custom earmold closely related to the firm's established hearing-care know-how and manufacturing capabilities, it is more likely to be refined and integrated than abandoned, although the weak website prominence suggests somewhat higher uncertainty.

This product builds directly on the firm's existing expertise in customised in-ear hearing solutions, and its dedicated product page indicates enough strategic commitment and learning potential to justify continuing it.

A vacuum thermoforming unit fits the firm's established equipment business and lab-oriented customer base, so its relatedness to existing knowledge and service capabilities makes continued development more likely than withdrawal.
